products.title: DeerValley DV-1SD021208 34" Frameless Neo-Angle Corner Shower Enclosure with Pivot Door, Chrome

description.html: Create a clean, open corner shower with the DeerValley DV-1SD021208 frameless neo-angle shower enclosure. Designed with 5/16" clear tempered glass and a smooth pivot door, it combines comfortable entry with a modern, space-conscious look. Chrome-finish stainless steel hardware, magnetic water seals and two optional glass shelves bring everyday durability and convenience to your bathroom. Features 01｜Frameless Neo-Angle Design Open Up Your Corner Shower The frameless neo-angle design creates a clean, open look while making efficient use of corner space, ideal for modern bathrooms where every inch matters. 02｜23.46" Walk-Through Opening Comfortable Entry, Every Day A 23.46" walk-through opening provides comfortable access, while the pivot door keeps the enclosure practical for everyday use. 03｜Return-Action Pivot Hinges Smooth, Guided Door Closing Return-action pivot hinges help guide the glass door toward the closed position, delivering smoother everyday operation and more consistent alignment. 04｜Magnetic Water-Seal System Designed to Keep Water Where It Belongs A full-length magnetic strip works with PVC water seals and a lower water guide to support secure door closure and help reduce splashing when properly installed. 05｜5/16" Tempered Glass Thick Glass, Open Feel 5/16" (8 mm) clear tempered glass delivers a substantial everyday feel while maintaining the bright, open appearance of a frameless shower. 06｜304 Stainless Steel Hardware Built for Humid Bathrooms Chrome-finish 304 stainless steel hinges, brackets and bar handle provide durable, corrosion-resistant support designed for everyday bathroom environments. 07｜Two Glass Shelves Storage Right Where You Need It Two included glass shelves keep shampoo, soap and shower essentials within easy reach—and can be omitted for an even cleaner, minimalist look. Before You Buy 1.Precise Installation Required This enclosure does not provide out-of-plumb adjustment. Finished walls must be plumb and the threshold must be flat and level to support proper alignment, magnetic closure and sealing. 2.What's Included Includes the glass enclosure, two optional glass shelves and installation hardware. Shower base and wall panels are sold separately. 3.2-Year Limited Warranty Backed by DeerValley's 2-year limited warranty for added peace of mind.
